_notes._starter: This is the neutral starter kit. Every value marked here is a placeholder: the video-template skill replaces them from the business's own website and assets, then deletes this key.
_notes.logo: File name inside the kit folder (e.g. "logo.svg"), copied from the owner's assets. logo_style: "plain" fades it in; "neon" flickers it on like a sign (for neon-style logos).
_notes.business: What kind of business this is ("software consultancy", "bakery", "yoga studio") and what its reels are for. Read it from the site or assets; ask if it isn't clear. It sets the sample copy in kit/sample-edit.json and the tone of every reel.
_notes.hours: List of {"days": "MON–FRI", "time": "6A–8P"}. Ask the owner or read them from their booking system; never invent hours. The out card skips the hours block while this is empty.
_notes.hook: How every reel opens. mode "template": the kit fixes the opening line (text, with "/" between stacked lines, and strike = the beat its strike-through starts, or null) and every reel uses it. mode "jit": videomaker writes a fresh hook for each reel from its topic. style is the text style it uses.
_notes.start_card: "bug" = the logo fades in small over the hook footage within one bar; the hook line owns frame 0. "full" = a full logo card on black for the first bar. "none" = no start card.
_notes.voice: Lines the business already uses (site, signage, past posts). Reels only put these or the owner's own words on screen; never invented claims, stats or testimonials.
_notes.safe: The text box inside the Instagram Reels UI: clear of the top 220 px, bottom 420 px and the right 150 px of the lower two-thirds.
